title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-031
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA records, press releases, and media logs regarding the JAL 1628 UFO sighting incident, confirming the presence of encounter reports.

encounters.summary: JAL Flight 1628 crew reported being paced by unidentified objects with white and yellow strobe lights for approximately 50 miles over Alaska.
encounters.entity_appearance: Two small brightly lit objects and one enormous object described as twice the size of an aircraft carrier.
encounters.entity_behavior: Paced the aircraft, changed altitude, and moved from front to side/rear of the flight.
encounters.quote: The unknown aircraft accompanied the JAL flight for about 50 miles

encounters.summary: Captain Terauchi reported a second sighting of irregular lights while flying over Alaska.
encounters.entity_behavior: Approached from the front, went underneath the aircraft, and reappeared behind it.
encounters.quote: irregular lights, looks like a spaceship
